1. Official MCPs are everywhere, but they still leave gaps

Every Dev/Infra app (10/10) and 8/10 apps in Productivity and Data/Scraping already ship first-party MCP servers. In practice they still have sharp limits: Intercom's MCP is US-hosted workspaces only, HubSpot blocks deletes, Clay and ClickUp are OAuth-only (blocking headless agent loops), and Atlassian's consumes Rovo credits. Managing auth cleanly and filling missing actions is where a unified toolkit still wins.

2. "Free sandbox, gated production" is the main hidden blocker

13 apps look self-serve on a quick check because developer sandboxes are free, but production requires app review, business verification, or PII security audits that take weeks. Half of Marketing/Ads (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads) and 4/10 Fintech apps (Plaid, QuickBooks, Brex, Ramp) sit here. Ops should submit those review apps before engineering starts building.

3. Easiest wins vs. where outreach is required

Dev/Infra (7/10 Ship Today, 0 blocked), Productivity (7/10, 0 blocked), and CRM (6/10) are the fastest categories to ship. Finance/Fintech has the heaviest drag (only 2/10 Ship Today: Stripe and iPayX). Only 7 apps genuinely block engineering pending enterprise or partner outreach: DealCloud, Gladly, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Waterfall.io, Paygent Connect, PitchBook, and NotebookLM Enterprise.

4. Three edge cases break the standard REST connector model

Sherlock (#58) and Mermaid CLI (#98) have no hosted API and should be packaged as sandboxed CLI skills. Otter AI (#92) has no general REST API at all, so the only path is proxying its official OAuth MCP (mcp.otter.ai/mcp). Meanwhile Higgsfield (#97) looked like a CLI tool from the hint URL, but actually has a full async REST API.

How the Agent Ran & How Accuracy Was Verified

The source repo runs a 3-pass async Python pipeline built on the current composio SDK v2 (composio.sessions.create with Tavily/Firecrawl/Exa + direct httpx fallback) and strict Pydantic v2 enums.

Pass 1 · pass1_research.py

Discovery & Structured Extraction

Starts from each app's hint URL, pulls official developer docs through a Composio session, and extracts into strict enums with incremental JSON caching.

Pass 2 · pass2_verify.py

Link Check + Critic Loop

Checks every cited doc URL over HTTP, re-fetches low-confidence or ambiguous gating rows, and runs a separate Critic prompt to flag stale v1 APIs, missed MCPs, and hidden prod gates.

Pass 3 · pass3_audit.py

20-App Human Spot Check

Stratified sample of 2 apps per category, intentionally weighted toward low-confidence and tricky apps, manually checked against live vendor docs.

Where a human was still needed: Rebrands broke single-domain crawlers (FanBasis moved its developer docs to commasdocs.com). Two-tier gating (free sandbox vs. partner-gated OAuth on Aircall, Plaid, and Meta/LinkedIn Ads) often sits in footnotes away from the quickstart page. Finally, white-label gateways without public docs like Paygent Connect (#84) can't be verified without merchant credentials, so flagging the gap is the right answer.
